Paul Taylor Dance Company

Paul Taylor Dance Company

Paul Taylor Dance Company brings its innovative modern dance repertory to the Presidio Theatre for a rare three-night San Francisco engagement, performing beloved classics alongside bold new works from the company's celebrated founder.

Content advisory: recommended for all audiences.

PAUL TAYLOR was one of the most influential choreographers of the 20th century, founding his company in 1954 and creating over 140 works during his lifetime.
